info.name: WAB Customer API
info.description: Generated by `npm run docs`. Do not edit by hand.

item.name: Auth
Send an OTP code on WhatsApp

request.description: Public. The platform limits run first (5 requests / 5 min, resend after 60 s, 15 min block); then the server sends a new code on WhatsApp in the `Accept-Language` language (ar default). A blocked phone or a running resend countdown answers 200 with `allowed: false` and sends nothing. A number WhatsApp cannot reach (not on WhatsApp) answers 422 `OTP_DELIVERY_FAILED` (the request still counts). A WhatsApp outage answers 503 `INTERNAL`.

item.name: Check the typed code and get an otpToken

request.description: Public. The right code (for this phone and purpose) is used up and answers `otpToken`. Errors: 401 `OTP_INVALID` (wrong code; `details[0].message` says how many attempts are left; the 5th wrong code blocks), 401 `OTP_EXPIRED` (no code, expired or already used: request a new one), 429 `OTP_BLOCKED` (blocked for 15 min).

item.name: Check a number before sending the OTP

request.description: LOGIN: 404 `PHONE_NOT_REGISTERED`, 403 `ACCOUNT_BLOCKED`. REGISTER: 409 `PHONE_ALREADY_REGISTERED`.

item.name: Log in with an otpToken

request.description: `otpToken` = the single-use proof from `POST /auth/otp/verify` (purpose LOGIN) for this phone. An account in its deletion grace period is restored. Errors: `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED` (401), `OTP_BLOCKED` (429), `ACCOUNT_BLOCKED` (403), `PHONE_NOT_REGISTERED` (404).

item.name: Register with an otpToken

request.description: Creates the account and signs it in. `otpToken` from `POST /auth/otp/verify` (purpose REGISTER), single use. Errors: `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED`, `OTP_BLOCKED`, `PHONE_ALREADY_REGISTERED` (409).

item.name: Rotate the refresh token

request.description: Returns a new access and refresh token. Reusing an old refresh token ends every session of that login (401).

item.name: Log out

request.description: Revokes the refresh token and unlinks the device. Always succeeds for well-formed tokens.

item.name: Change the phone number

request.description: Needs an `otpToken` (purpose CHANGE_PHONE) of the NEW number. Errors: `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED`, `OTP_BLOCKED`, `PHONE_ALREADY_REGISTERED`.

item.name: Installations
Register or update this device

request.description: Firebase app-instance id, FCM token and versions. Works for guests; with a customer token the device is also linked to the account, which joins the guest analytics history to it. A push token belongs to one device: registering it here removes it from any other.

item.name: Turn push notifications on or off

request.description: One switch for the whole account. Off means no push is sent, but notifications still appear in the in-app list.

item.name: App config
Version policy, maintenance, OTP and discovery settings

request.description: Public. Called at launch with the installed version: tells the app whether it must or may update, whether maintenance is on, plus OTP length/resend and the nearby radius.

item.name: Catalog
Active catalog services of one gender (paginated, localized)
Uploads
Get a presigned upload URL for a purpose (type, size and expiry are restricted)
Confirm an uploaded file (real type and size are checked); rejected files are deleted
Salon search
Search LIVE salons of one gender: name text, ALL selected services offered, price range of their sum (JOD strings), minimum rating, recommended

request.description: Public; a valid customer token only adds `isFavorite`. Combined filters are all applied (AND). Ordered by rating.

item.name: Price slider bounds for the selected services (min/max of the sums over matching salons)
Salon details
Salon details (S07): hours, closures, staff, services, gallery

request.description: Public; a valid customer token only adds `isFavorite`. A salon that is not LIVE and complete is 404 `SALON_NOT_FOUND`. With `branchId` (a bookable branch, else 404 `BRANCH_NOT_FOUND`) `staff` and `services` are that branch's only and the place fields are the branch's; without it they cover every bookable branch, each tagged with its `branchId`.

item.name: Staff sheet of a salon member who provides services

request.description: Services are the member's own branch services; a member of an unbookable branch is 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

item.name: Home
Home (S03): banners, services, recommended and nearest salons in one request

request.description: Public; a valid customer token adds `firstName`, `unreadCount` and `isFavorite`. `nearest` is null unless `lat` and `lng` are sent; it lists one entry per bookable branch (§5.17). Each section holds 10 items; `hasMore` shows See more / See all.

item.name: Favorites
My favorite salons (S20), newest first

request.description: Salons that are no longer visible to customers are left out of the page.

item.name: Save a salon (idempotent). Only LIVE, complete salons can be saved.
Remove a salon from favorites (idempotent)
Reviews
Salon reviews (S08)
Review a salon (rating 1-5, optional comment). Any active customer; no booking needed. Waits for approval; 429 when too many pending reviews exist for this salon.
Staff reviews (S09)
Review a staff member (independent of the salon rating)
Customer profile
My profile (S21/S22)
Edit personal information. The phone number changes only through `/auth/change-phone` (OTP).
Delete my account: deactivated for the grace period (30 days by default), then anonymized; signing in again within it restores it. All sessions end.
Set the profile photo from a confirmed CUSTOMER_AVATAR upload
Remove the profile photo (back to the default avatar)
Availability
Slots of one person on one date with the free eligible staff per slot (a read; POST because of the body)

request.description: Ask once per person; send the times the earlier persons picked in `others` so the same staff member is not offered twice. `reason` explains a day without slots: PAST, TOO_FAR or CLOSED. A slot is available when at least one eligible staff member is free for the whole duration (existing PENDING/APPROVED bookings and live payment holds count as busy).

item.name: Booking drafts
Validate and price a booking (summary step), hold the slots for `booking.paymentHoldMinutes` and snapshot prices and the salon policy. Replaces the customer’s earlier draft.

request.description: Persons are checked in order and each pick blocks the next. Errors (422): SALON_NOT_BOOKABLE, TOO_MANY_COMPANIONS, GENDER_MISMATCH, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, BRIDE_ONLY_SERVICE, STAFF_NOT_ELIGIBLE, SALON_CLOSED, DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE, SLOT_UNAVAILABLE, PAYMENT_OPTION_NOT_ALLOWED.

item.name: My draft; an expired one is 422 `DRAFT_EXPIRED`
Discard my draft and free its held slots (idempotent)

Confirm the booking with the OTP (purpose BOOKING_CONFIRMATION): the `otpToken` (from `POST /auth/otp/verify`) must belong to the customer’s own phone; it works once. Required before the booking is created.
Bookings
My bookings: upcoming or past, search by reference or salon name (paginated)
Create the booking from a confirmed draft (status PENDING, waits for the salon). Deposit and full-payment drafts are created from their verified payment (the booking then shows the paid amounts).

request.description: Needs the draft’s OTP confirmation (`verify-otp`), else 422 `OTP_INVALID`. The slots are re-validated under a lock per staff member and date: a slot that went away answers 409 `SLOT_TAKEN`. An expired draft is 422 `DRAFT_EXPIRED`; an online draft needs a verified payment (SUCCEEDED, exact amount, not used before) else 422 `PAYMENT_NOT_VERIFIED`; when the slot went away after payment the whole payment is refunded at once and the answer is 409 `SLOT_TAKEN`.

item.name: Cancel my booking: a pending one any time (full refund), an approved one only inside the salon’s cancellation window.

request.description: After the window the answer is 422 `CANCELLATION_WINDOW_PASSED`. `refundDue` (JOD) is what the refund flow will return, by the salon’s policy.

item.name: One of my bookings with persons, money, policy snapshot and status history
Payments
Start (or resume) the online payment of a confirmed booking draft

request.description: The draft must be unexpired and OTP-confirmed with an online payment option (else 422 `DRAFT_EXPIRED` / `OTP_INVALID` / `PAYMENT_OPTION_NOT_ALLOWED`). A running or successful attempt is returned again; after a failed or cancelled one a new attempt starts. The booking itself is created afterwards, only from a verified payment.

item.name: Ask the server to verify the payment with the gateway (the app’s own word is never trusted)
Notifications
Notification list (S19), newest first, with date range, text and unread filters
Unread notifications (bell badge)
Mark own notifications as read (idempotent; unknown or foreign ids are ignored)
